# HybridConvexOptimization

**Domain**: TCC
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A floorplanning method that combines convex and non-convex optimization techniques to jointly optimize chip layout and interconnect topology. Enables more efficient exploration of the design space for topology-centric computing, where interconnect structure heavily influences performance.
